title: Academic Coaching in Modern Online Education
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: In modern online education, academic coaching is a critical support system for student success. As virtual learning environments expand, the role of academic coaches becomes important in bridging the gap between course content and student engagement. By providing personalized guidance and accountability, academic coaching empowers learners to navigate the challenges of online education and achieve long-term academic and personal goals.
